pages.text: Gluttonous Scales are a widely used material, including for unique tools, weapons and armor. They can be harvested from the sides of a $(l:offsprings/maw)$(c)$(o)Gorger$() using a $(b)Diamond Pickaxe$(). The scales can also be compacted into a full block or used as a trimming material for customizing armor pieces.
If it is intended for decorational uses, it would be better to create $(l:blocks/imitation_scales)$(c)$(o)imitations$() to save on resources.
